name: talk-hello
prompt: Casual founder video, talking straight to camera. A friendly man in his late twenties with warm brown skin, short dark curly hair, thin round tortoiseshell glasses, light stubble and a cream chunky knit sweater sits at a light-oak desk in a bright plant-filled apartment, a silver laptop beside him. He smiles and speaks in a relaxed, warm voice with natural pauses and small hand gestures: "Hey. I kept losing my train of thought every time I opened a new tab to ask AI something. So I built Flare. Press command shift space in any app, ask, and keep going. And every chat stays on your Mac." At the end he taps the laptop keyboard and grins. Soft morning light, handheld, natural room tone, realistic lip sync. No text, no music, no logos.
